rappel_detail.station: The top of the hidden ramp below the notch, after reversing the exposed heather ledge across the north face.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional short rappel, or a hand line, on the ramp when it is wet or for less experienced members; the rest of the descent is downclimbed.
hazards: The one-foot-wide ledge above is the crux in both directions and much more dangerous when wet, icy or snowy; consider a hand line there too.

set.rappels: 1 optional short rappel (or a hand line) on the hidden ramp when wet; otherwise the descent is downclimbed
